title: Registry Skill Frontmatter
description: Canonical schema for YAML frontmatter of Registry Skills (skills/<name>/SKILL.md). This file is the single source of truth — docs and validators derive from it.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier. Must match the directory name.

version.description: Semantic versioning: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. No leading zeros.

description.description: 1-2 sentences: what the skill does and when it activates. Primary input for agent semantic routing.

globs.description: File glob patterns that auto-activate this skill. May be empty for intent-only skills.

intents.description: Natural language phrases that trigger this skill. Recommended 2-5.

default_mode.description: auto = activate on match, always = always active, manual = explicit only.

dependencies.description: Flat list of skill names this skill requires.
